Found: Sealed in a crypt in an abandoned house in Venice in 18██
ContainmentProcedure: keep in hermetically sealed glass case, 10cm thick. Room walls are Steel/Lead Alloy. doors have 3 locks. Minimum 2 Guards at all times. Replace case every 2 weeks, dispose of old case through SCP-101
Description: white porcelain Comedy Mask, on occasion it takes on the appearance of a Tragedy Mask. this change to a from will affect all visual records of the entity including Printed Images
